## Reference e-book

The following R e-book is also acknowledged as a reference for these materials:

Harrer, M., Cuijpers, P., Furukawa, T. A., & Ebert, D. D. (2021).
[*Doing Meta-Analysis with R: A Hands-On Guide*](https://doing-meta.guide/).
Boca Raton, FL and London: Chapman & Hall/CRC Press.
ISBN 978-0-367-61007-4.
